name: speculator_benchmarks
description:
This dataset contains dataset splits for evaluating speculative decoding algorithms on different tasks.  
File: 

Coding: HumanEval.jsonl
Math: math_reasoning.jsonl
Question Answering: qa.jsonl
MT_bench: question.jsonl
Retrieval-Augmented Generation: rag.jsonl
Summarization: summarization.jsonl
Translation (German to English): translation.jsonl
Writing: writing.jsonl

The data comes from two sources: 

https://github.com/openai/human-eval (1). (The MIT License)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RedHatAI/speculator_benchmarks.
evaluation_method: task-specific (pass@k for HumanEval/code, exact_match/accuracy for QA/math, BLEU for translation, ROUGE/ROUGE-L for summarization)
general_score_metric: task-specific (pass@k for code; exact_match/accuracy for QA/math; BLEU/ROUGE for NLG/translation)
reputation: A collection assembled for evaluating speculative decoding across multiple established datasets (e.g., HumanEval); modest community usage as a task-aggregation resource.
